title: Bottom-line association downloads
bodyHtml:
We meta-analyze all GWAS summary statistics that we incorporate into the Knowledge Portals, using a process that we term bottom-line integrative analysis. Here we offer downloads of trans-ancestry bottom-line associations for selected phenotypes. We will provide downloads for additional phenotypes in the future.

To see the list of datasets that went into the meta-analysis for a phenotype, click on the Phenotype ID in the table. The link leads to the Phenotype page for that phenotype, where the list of datasets is displayed.
